newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Computer Systems lists at 8.80 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Computer Systems lists at 8.80 rgt.

text.p: Computer Systems Advisers (M) Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board on Monday at 8.80 ringgit a share against an offer price of 2.80 ringgit.
At 0135 GMT, the stock of the systems integrator was trading at 9.70 ringgit. It offered 5.985 million shares.
Jupiter Securities, in a report issued last week, estimated fair value of Computer Systems at 8.00 ringgit a share, which works out to a price-to-earnings ratio of 20.

The company is a principal distributor of Sun Microsystems Inc, with a focus on Sun's Java programming language. Computer Systems' projects include the Broker Front End Application for the securities industry.
Computer Systems will be part of Malaysia's Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC) high-technology zone project.
For the year ended December 31 1997, it has forecast pre-tax profit of 19.12 million ringgit or net earnings per share of 40 cents based on weighted average shares of 33.54 million.
It has forecast net profit for this calendar year of 13.38 million ringgit. This compares with net profit of 10.87 million ringgit in 1996 and pre-tax profit of 15.42 million ringgit.
